squire-a#0.notes: Squire: small freckled boy under a round steel cap with a crimson kite shield with a gold-yellow cross far too big for him; matches the Pulp Wars Fighter and Swordsman crimson heraldry; reads at 1:1 on light and dark; feet lowest, nothing under it, faces south-east

late-king-a#0.notes: a wheeled cart pulled by two black beasts (read as bears or pigs), not a litter; king too small for the canvas

late-king-b#0.notes: Late King: big crowned ivory skull mid-proclamation with violet eyes, ermine collar, violet-trimmed near-black cape and a scroll, on a litter-cart borne by two little ivory skeletons; Restless bone, near-black and violet palette like the Pulp Wars skeleton and vampire; reads as the biggest Restless unit at 1:1; one wheel left despite the exclusion, accepted as a litter-cart

boomshaman-a#0.notes: stands on a soil and grass patch (a ground plate); olive rather than lime skin; the rod reads as a torch

boomshaman-b#0.notes: Boomshaman: lime goblin with frizzled white hair, sand-buff hide robe, hazard yellow trim and a forked tin lightning rod with a yellow spark; same lime and hide as the Pulp Wars goblin and bomb chucker; no ground; reads as a caster, not a spear goblin, by the hair and the spark

friar-a#0.notes: Friar: jolly tonsured monk in a cream habit with a crimson rope belt and gold cross, birch quarterstaff and gold sparkles of a blessing; plump body differs from every Realm soldier; light dominant material; nothing under it, faces south-east

dragonslayer-a#0.notes: Dragonslayer: very large knight in light steel plate with a crimson plume, crimson surcoat with gold-yellow cross and a greatsword, a stuffed green dragon head trophy peeking over the shoulder; fills the giant canvas; same steel and crimson heraldry as the Pulp Wars swordsman and knight but twice the mass; nothing under it

orc-warboss-giant-a#0.notes: Orc Warboss (giant, bzc.29): the imported warboss's design at the tier 6 canvas: horned steel helmet, lime face with tusks shouting, pale sand fur mantle, iron belt buckle, yellow loincloth, brass war horn; matches the Dragonslayer's scale and the Bold chibi style; reads at 1:1 on light and dark; feet lowest

gingerbread-man-a#0.notes: cookie soldier with an icing face, gumdrop buttons and a candy-cane spear; clear silhouette, bold outline, matches the Squire's scale

taffy-wrangler-a#0.notes: reads as a pink pig cowpoke with a snout in brown clothes, not a creature made of taffy

rock-candy-dragon-a#0.notes: head turned south-west (to the left), against the never-mirrored south-east rule; smooth scales read as an ordinary teal dragon, not rock candy facets

rock-candy-dragon-b#0.notes: faceted teal rock-candy dragon with pink crystal spikes and gems, sugar-glass wings, faces south-east; giant canvas filled, reads at 1x

taffy-wrangler-b#0.notes: the taffy creature, hat and striped lasso are right, but it stands on a grass and soil ground plate (removed by the taffy-wrangler-b-clean edit)

taffy-wrangler-b-clean#0.notes: ground plate gone, the taffy cowpoke, hat, neckerchief and striped lasso kept; reads as a candy creature at 1x

taffy-wrangler-b-clean#1.notes: spare: same clean edit as #0, which is accepted

peppermint-archer-a#0.notes: peppermint-swirl hood, candy-cane bow and mint tunic; clearly an archer, chibi proportions like the Squire

gummy-bear-a#0.notes: glossy red gummy bear with a sugar crust and a wide grin; solid, reads as jelly, fills the large canvas

sugarplum-a#0.notes: the plum fairy with wings and lollipop wand is right, but a floating grass block hangs under her (removed by the sugarplum-a-clean edit)

sugarplum-a-clean#0.notes: clean and on-style, but on the battle line-up the round plum reads smaller than the tier 1 Gingerbread Man; replaced by sugarplum-b

sugarplum-a-clean#1.notes: spare: same clean edit as #0, which keeps the wand sparkles

sugarplum-b#0.notes: a sugarplum fairy in a plump plum body with spun-sugar wings and a swirl lollipop wand; fills the canvas so the tier 4 caster reads bigger than the tier 1 Gingerbread Man; no ground

sugarplum-c#0.notes: smaller than sugarplum-b (1414 opaque px against 1839; the Wrangler has 2036) and the pale yellow wings nearly vanish on a light panel

sugarplum-d#0.notes: same visual mass as sugarplum-b (1870 opaque px against 1839), but the dense white sugar dots are noise at 1x; sugarplum-b keeps the cleaner silhouette

tinker-a#0.notes: a good dwarf but the signature wrench is a small stub behind the shoulder; re-rolled as tinker-b with the wrench across the front

tinker-b#0.notes: the big brass wrench is right but it stands on a grass and soil block; ground removed by the edit tinker-b-clean

tinker-b-clean#0.notes: stout ginger-bearded dwarf in a verdigris cap and brass goggles, apron, back boiler with a steam puff, a big brass wrench across her front; nothing under the boots; reads on light and dark

mortar-a#0.notes: round riveted brass-copper automaton on stubby iron legs, porthole eyes, a fat barrel up to the right with a steam puff, wind-up key; a cute walking gun that fills the standard canvas

steam-tank-a#0.notes: the ram nose is an open cannon barrel and reads as a gun (the Steam Tank rams, it does not shoot); fixed by the edit steam-tank-a-ram

steam-tank-a-ram#0.notes: chubby verdigris tank on iron tracks, porthole eyes, copper chimney and a big white steam cloud, a closed riveted brass ram head on a log instead of the barrel

steam-tank-a-ram#1.notes: near-identical to take 0 with fewer rivets on the ram head (spare)

rivet-gunner-a#0.notes: grey-bearded dwarf in a verdigris helmet and goggles, a chunky brass rivet gun fed by a hose from a copper back tank; tells apart from the ginger Tinker

gyrocopter-a#0.notes: right design but small (about 44x40 in 56x80): would read smaller than the tier 2 Rivet Gunner; re-rolled to fill the canvas

gyrocopter-b#0.notes: big round brass pod with a wide iron rotor, stubby wings, a goggled dwarf pilot (white beard, not ginger: accepted) and an exhaust steam puff; fills the canvas, hovers with nothing under it

ironclad-a#0.notes: a walking iron-and-verdigris fortress with brass trim, porthole eyes, a brass turret cannon pointing bottom right, twin smokestacks with white steam, stubby feet; the biggest of the six
